item.title: Re: My SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
1) If this is negotiating with The Foundation specifically, then that means it has some sapience. This may give The Foundation a reason to try and determine if it can work out a better deal. Even if it's just basically an animal, the reason for targeting The Foundation needs to be explored.

2) Along those lines, an MTF or D-Class may be the wrong idea: The Foundation using this as a prison for its own prisoners or as a way to soften up those it interrogates may be a possibility. This would give the apartment its prisoners and give The Foundation a way to make those it arrests useful beyond any information they may otherwise offer.

Of course, there's nothing to say that the apartment could have an exclusive deal.

3) You need to emphasize the maze-like structure of the apartment. The devil's bargain works (prisoner for info/treasure) but you need to emphasize how hard it is to escape. That would create a much scarier location.

Otherwise, great idea! And your English isn't that bad.

item.title: Re: My SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
It's a pretty simple concept. There's nothing wrong simplicity per se, but the simpler your idea, the more the article will need to be carried by the quality of the execution. The success of an article like this will depend pretty much entirely on your ability to create an atmosphere that draws the reader in and creates a sense of dread.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: High danger level and unic containiment procedures recommending you to poison yourself to avoid the anomaly

In fiction, something being "dangerous" does not necessarily make it scary or interesting to the reader. Honestly, my attention isn't being grabbed by this, and the way you relied so strongly on a movie scene to convey your idea doesn't inspire my confidence in your ability execute this concept at the level of skill it requires. I understand that the language barrier might be an issue, though, so I won't hold it against you.

we read a letter by the apartment past owner that tells us it’s backstory…

This sounds pretty significant to the story, so it's strange that you've mentioned it as an afterthought here. What does the backstory tell us about the anomaly? How does it enhance the mood you want to convey? You're seeking a greenlight, but I can't evaluate your ideas properly if you haven't thought them through yet.

Overall it sounds like you have a pretty long article in mind, supported by some very broad ideas. That's doesn't mean you're doomed to fail by default, but it does present some rather sizeable challenges for you. If you decide to proceed, my advice for your next step is that you create a (reasonably) detailed outline for how you intend the article to flow from start to finish.

item.title: My SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Elevator Pitch: So the SCP is an area (currently affecting an appartamento in Moscow, plot twist is that the area is growing), that traps people within the area, it keeps its victims alive as it feeds on something, remember that’s scene from 7 where they find the murderers first victim which he kept chained to a bed for months, and how the SWAT recognized him as alive only after he started coughing? Yeah, imagine something like that when thinking about these SCPs victims. The more the victim spends inside the area the harder it is to escape as the reality changes and non-ecleudian spaces around them become more and more severe. The SCP lure people into itself with SCP-A and SCP-B. B is audio lures like screams of help and cats purring, A is treasures like important intel and money. The foundation used to send a lot of D-class into the affected area in order to collect A, the anomaly seemed to target the foundation specifically as the treasures more and more often became intel on GOIs and expensive amnestics. Now the expeditions are stopped indefinitely after the area started growing. The final twist: we read a letter by the apartment past owner that tells us it’s backstory and shows a very spooky image I found of a statue affected by acid rain

Central Narrative: there is a long description and average exploration log, some addendums

Hook/Attention-Grabber: High danger level and unic containiment procedures recommending you to poison yourself to avoid the anomaly

Additional Notes: White rabbits is underrated and I wanted to use that MTF, have some more original ideas (a photo that turns everything into being wheelchair bound, has backstory and some ~strange~ consequences if… nah, no spoilers) but wanted to start of simple as am not good at formatting and the wiki in general. I know that my grammar is bad, am Russian and use a dictionary when writing the SCP itself so it shouldn’t be as bad there
